description: Run a saved skill by name or id (from list_skills). This call invokes NO model: it resolves the skill's instructions and records the run, and YOU — the connected AI, on your own subscription, never metered — are the one who carries out `instructions` against `inputs`. An agent applies a skill when the skill is named in that agent's Skills field. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES run_skill"]

inputs.description: Free-form inputs this run should apply the skill to — returned alongside the instructions for you to act on, not sent to the API.

name: run_skill
title: Run skill
